blocks.title: Worked example · Reorder 1,2,3
blocks.text: Packets can follow different routes or encounter different queue delays. With a reliable transport such as TCP, sequence numbers permit correct reordering before delivery of the byte stream; missing data can be retransmitted.

blocks.title: Compare shared packet links
blocks.text: A circuit-switched system sets aside end-to-end resources while active; ordinary packet-switched IP shares links dynamically with others. Circuit switching offers predictable reserved capacity but can waste it during silence; packet switching adapts.
